theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_dtop_cp_leibniz_smul_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : Euclid Q → ℝ) (g : Euclid Q → F), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Euclid Q), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => f y • g y) x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k - i) g x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
